title: Ye Reethiga – Kamlakhar, Anwesshaa Telugu Christian Lyrics

intro: Ye Reethiga is the latest Telugu Christian song written, produced by Joshua Shaik, sung by Anwesshaa Dutt and music composed by Thrahimam fame, Pranam Kamalakar. This song video was released on February 08, 2024 through Joshua Shaik Ministries YouTube channel.
